xcellence.name: xCellence
story: Since 2022, xCellence has been promoting robotics and STEAM in Kazakhstan. We are now in our 4th generation of students.
We started and mentored xCeption and several FLL teams, and we publish the guides we wish we had when we began.

about.title: Who we are
about.text: We are NIS Nura Robotics Lab, a robotics community at Nazarbayev Intellectual School in Astana, Kazakhstan. Our lab brings together two teams, xCeption and xCellence, united by a passion for engineering, innovation and teamwork. Together, we design, build and program robots while developing the next generation of STEM leaders.

first.title: Why FIRST
first.text: FIRST is a global robotics organization that inspires young people to become science and technology leaders. Through FIRST Tech Challenge, our teams engineer robots, compete in challenges and develop real-world skills in programming, design, problem-solving and collaboration. Beyond competition, we share knowledge, mentor others and inspire more students to explore STEM.

packages.title: Ways to partner
packages.intro: Three packages. Details and current prices are in the proposal, or write to us and we will tailor one.

items.name: Brand & Merch Partner
items.for: For companies that want to be visibly associated with the team and its results.
perks: Your logo on team clothing, banners and branded materials
Your brand on stickers, print materials and our pit area at competitions and forums
Mentions in posts about competitions and events
items.outcome: Long-term visibility and an association with technology and achievement.

items.name: Event Partner
items.for: For companies that support educational and technology events and want to reach new STEM students.
perks: Official partner of the team's events
Brand integration at the Girls Go First forum (with Panheya) and the city STEM hackathon
Logo on presentations, event screens, banners and the team uniform
Steady mentions on the team's social media, plus a post and a series of stories about the partnership
Your representatives at events: networking and direct contact with participants
items.outcome: Direct access to schoolchildren and students interested in STEM.

items.name: Tech & Development Partner
items.for: The key partner behind the team's technical development and competitiveness.
perks: Your logo on robots, key technical elements, print materials and the team uniform
Mentions in everything about development, testing and competition
Your brand in engineering cases and project presentations
Priority mentions in media and team reports, plus a post and stories series
items.outcome: Your brand inside the engineering process, on the robots, all season.
